hooks.prompt: Auto-compaction is about to happen. Write an emergency mini-checkpoint to preserve session state. Steps: (1) Determine the current date and working topic from available context. (2) Create docs/[DATE] - Auto-Checkpoint/Mini-Checkpoint-auto.md with: Summary, What Was Done, Current Status, Next Steps, Files to Read First. (3) Update docs/sessions/[DATE]-context.yaml if it exists — add or merge client data. (4) Keep it fast — you have 60 seconds. Prioritize capturing next steps and files modified over completeness.

hooks.command: bash -c 'LATEST=$(ls -t docs/sessions/*-context.yaml 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$LATEST" ]; then echo "[SESSION RESTORED FROM AUTO-CHECKPOINT]"; cat "$LATEST"; fi'
